about_the_game:
Ultima Chess VR is a new kind of strategy fusion with thrilling VR action in the fantasy realm of Ultima. Experience strategy on a new level: Every move is a clash epic. Your pieces are brought to life with warriors and magical creatures, and board fighting is filled with special effects, animations, and live commentary. It's not a casual game of chess – it's a real clash of mind and muscle in virtual reality.

Core mechanics in Demo:

✔ Classic chess with modern graphics

✔ VR support

✔ 1 visual stunning chess deck board

✔ 12 unique chess pieces

✔ Versus AI

✔ Rapid mode

Main features:

  • Immersive gaming: Complete VR support (SteamVR/Meta Quest).

  • Epic fantasy fighting: Every capture is a dynamic RPG-style fight.

  • Classic strategy: Despite playing a full-fledged chess game with official regulations. The built-in AI player will vary its level depending on your playing level – beginner, intermediate, and grandmaster levels. Practice needed? The game uses well-proven algorithms (Chess AI) for a clever and fair opponent.

  • Total accessibility: Uncluttered controls and clear, straightforward instructions make even virtual reality or chess novices play with confidence.

Be a hero in a chess legend:

Battle against formidable foes and rise as a grandmaster among Ultima's players. It's just as fascinating for VR players looking for something new to do as for players of traditional chess looking to bring back old favorites. Be prepared to move off the board – and onto a legendary battle of wits in Ultima Chess VR.

It's releasing on SEPTEMBER 19 – ADD TO WISHLIST and don't miss out on it!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 7600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR Launch Options (All Headsets Supported)

  • OS: Windows 10/11

  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 3070
